description: This file 'network.h' declares network-related functions and structures for the server, including initialization, closing, registration of file descriptor events, and socket activation management.

methods.name: network_accept_tcp_nagle_disable
methods.description: Disables TCP Nagle algorithm on the given file descriptor.

methods.name: network_init
methods.description: Initializes network components for the server.

methods.name: network_close
methods.description: Closes network resources associated with the server.

methods.name: network_register_fdevents
methods.description: Registers file descriptor events for the server.

methods.name: network_unregister_sock
methods.description: Unregisters a server socket from event monitoring.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_to_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables related to socket activation.
